summary: Solid delivery with comprehensive test harness. Critical issue: secret_rotation_validator.py lacks type hints entirely (no hints on any function signature—check_secret_status, load_secrets, build_report, render_*, main). For Python, this is a best_practices violation. Workflow is well-structured (pinned refs, minimal permissions, job deps); error handling in validate job could be more explicit (first two report steps fail silently on script errors). Test harness run_act_tests.sh uses excellent shell practices (set -euo pipefail, traps, proper quoting) but JSON parsing is fragile (searches for first JSON object with "summary" key—could fail with unexpected output). Strengths: clean separation of concerns, DRY, multiple output formats, comprehensive multi-assertion test coverage. Missing: actionlint validation verification shown in requirements. Add type hints to script; make test JSON extraction more robust (parse JSON from specific log section).
